name: market
description: Official market data tools through the Splice capability broker: token prices, DEX pairs and OHLCV candles (CoinGecko, DexScreener, GeckoTerminal on the host). Robinhood Chain and other DEX networks; no keys in the package.

tools.name: price
tools.description: Price of ETH or a token. Default network: Robinhood Chain (CoinGecko, then GeckoTerminal); other networks use provider ids (eth, base, solana…). Unlisted tokens are UNAVAILABLE — never estimated.

network.description: robinhood (default) or a provider network id

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { price, vs, … } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR

tools.name: pairs
tools.description: DEX pairs/pools of a token (DexScreener, then GeckoTerminal), each with the provider's price, liquidity, volume, transactions, FDV and market cap. Values are never averaged.

network.description: robinhood or a provider network id

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { network, token, pairs[] } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR

tools.name: candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles of a DEX pool (GeckoTerminal). timeframe day (aggregate 1), hour (1, 4, 12), minute (1, 5, 15); up to 1000 candles.

output.description: Host capability result: LIVE/CACHED with data { candles[] } and provenance, or UNAVAILABLE/ERROR
